eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 18 · SOSL & Search

code:
FIND {Acme} IN ALL FIELDS
RETURNING
  Account(Id, Name, Industry),
  Contact(Id, FirstName, LastName,
          Email),
  Lead(Id, Name, Company, Status)
caption: Without field lists you only get record Ids.

code:
RETURNING
  Account(Id, Name
    WHERE Industry = 'Technology'
    ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10),
  Contact(Id, LastName
    ORDER BY LastName),
  Lead(Id, Name
    WHERE IsConverted = false)
caption: WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT apply to one object only.

steps.label: List of lists
steps.sub: one list per object, in RETURNING order

steps.label: Not one table
steps.sub: each object has its own columns

subtitle: Moving from querying data to moving data.
